title: Vibrant Chinese Pork Tacos
description: A festive Chinese dish featuring crispy pork, mustardy slaw, and crunchy taco shells, this recipe is perfect for a fun and easy dinner. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook in the skillet until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, combine the shredded cabbage and grated carrots in a bowl.
Stir in the mustard until the slaw is well coated.
To assemble the tacos, place a few pieces of the cooked pork into a taco shell, followed by a spoonful of the slaw.
